Gosti na svom telefonu i na svom jeziku:
On their own phone and in their own language, guests find everything about the hotel, send a request to the reception, order room service or book the spa.
          The reception sees it all on one screen and answers with one click — no app for guests and no phone calls.
Sve što gost treba — i sve što recepcija: Everything guests need — and everything the reception needs to know
Jedna platforma za informacije, zahtjeve: One platform for information, requests, orders and announcements throughout the stay.
Odgovara gostima na pitanja o hotelu u b: Answers guests' questions about the hotel at any hour, in their language — only from the information you entered.
Bez aplikacije i registracije — otvara s: No app and no sign-up — it opens in the browser
Upišete sobe (npr. 101–120). Svaka soba: Enter the rooms (e.g. 101–120). Every room gets its own link, so the reception knows which room a request comes from.
Link pošaljete u poruci prije dolaska il: Send the link in a pre-arrival message or let guests open it in the room. Requests and orders reach the reception, guests get everything in their language.
Otvorite demo hotel na svom telefonu: Open the demo hotel on your phone
Ovo je pravi vodič izmišljenog demo hote: This is the real guide of a fictional demo hotel. Switch the language, send a request to the reception, look at room service and the extra services — exactly what your guests would see.
Ne. Gost otvori vodič linkom iz poruke i: No. Guests open the guide with a link from a message or a code in the room, and everything runs in the browser. No download, no sign-up.
